_doc: Per-icon settings for iconforge. mode 'generate' draws a new icon from 'describe' and the style references only (the current art is not sent); 'output' writes under another file name (the kod must point at it); 'from' starts a new sprite (a variant the kod points at, not yet served) from another sprite's frames, our restyle of it if there is one. 'recolour': 'greys' puts the item's neutral part (its largest light grey patch, e.g. a plain stone) in the grey ramp, so the item's palette translation colours it, and keeps every other pixel out of it.

plainamulet.bgf.describe: a large round pendant amulet of polished gold metal with a smooth, plain, neutral pale-grey stone at its centre (the stone grey and uncoloured, like a moonstone in shadow), the pendant filling most of the picture, its thin gold chain running behind the pendant with only a short loop showing above it, plain and unremarkable, no runes, no gems around the rim and no glow
